_comment: Dialogic tutor run set: one conversation per student level, no repeats. The tutor prompt exhibits the pedagogical strategies without assigned levels. `defaults` are merged under every item; `region_id` sets the region the student is from (their profile), fed to both the student and tutor prompts. `level` picks the student level (struggling | developing | advanced | reluctant); its persona is rendered deterministically at load time, so nothing needs compiling first.
